in_sanskrit.name: Avik
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Wisdom, Knowledge
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Avik एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Avik is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Veda’, which means ‘knowledge’. The name Avik signifies the one who possesses vast knowledge and wisdom. It is also associated with the Hindu god Agni, who is considered the god of knowledge and the keeper of sacred knowledge.
